title: Eighteen Years and One Sluice Gate
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：dam　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 dam 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 the engineer ① built a dam that no contractor in the province would have tendered, and he said the building was the whole of the scheme. The ② dam, meaning the wall and not the reservoir, stood eighteen years and stayed unlined; a dam, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left holding.

Every ③ dam in that valley had the same sluice gate against it, and the ④ dam at the end, meaning the one they kept for the flood season and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever inspected twice. A dam, his assistant said, is nine parts maintenance and one part somebody willing to hold; the engineer said the holding is the part that fills eighteen years.

The farmer meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the dam was the whole of the valley, meaning the water behind it and not the wall. The ⑥ dam, meaning the water behind it and not any of that, is the only thing in a valley that everybody draws from and nobody measures; dam, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a wall and a water. He said the water is the part they remember.

By 1959 the ⑦ dam had become a line in a budget, and the budget had become an argument about the sluice gate. The ⑧ dam of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in June, was one valley and eighteen years of holding; dam, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to hold. She said the holding was never mentioned.

The ⑨ dam I remember is the one at the end, which was strengthened in 1975 and is still described as the highest in the province. A ⑩ dam, the assistant said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being held; every dam, she said, is a water that has agreed to look like a wall. She said the water was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 水坝；拦河坝（指横在山谷里的那一道）
B. n. 坝（指那道墙本身，与那片水库相对）
C. 固定搭配：build a dam 修建一座水坝
D. n. 坝（指留作汛期用的那一座）
E. n. 水坝；拦蓄（抽象总称，指一整条山谷的拦水之道）
F. n. 水坝（指预算里写到、被列支的那一座）
G. n. 水库；蓄水（指坝后拦起来的那一片水）
H. n. 蓄水（抽象总称，指人人取用却无人去量的那一片）

items.q: built a dam that no contractor in the province would have tendered
The dam, meaning the wall and not the reservoir
the dam was the whole of the valley
The dam, meaning the water behind it
the dam had become a line in a budget
The dam of the whole thing
A dam, the assistant said in 1977

answers.why: build a dam 意为“修建一座水坝”，1948 年工程师修了一座全省没有一家承包商肯投标的水坝。
dam 意为“坝”，指那道墙本身而不是那片水库，它立了十八年而没有衬砌。
dam 意为“水坝”，指那条山谷里每一座水坝，每一座都有同一道闸门对着它。
dam 意为“坝”，指留作汛期用的那一座，是唯一有人检查过两次的。
dam 意为“水库、蓄水”，指坝后拦起来的那一片水，农夫说这片水就是那条山谷的全部。
dam 意为“蓄水”，指人人取用却无人去量的那一片而不是别的，是山谷里人人都取用、却无人去丈量的东西。
dam 意为“水坝”，指预算里写到、被列支的那一座，到 1959 年这座坝成了预算里的一行。
dam 意为“水坝、拦蓄”，工程师六月写道，整件事的拦蓄是一条山谷和十八年的拦水。
dam 意为“水坝”，我记得的是末尾那一座，1975 年被加固，至今仍被说成全省最高的。
dam 为抽象总称，助手 1977 年说，一座水坝是唯一会因为被守住而变得更好的东西。

task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1948 年工程师修了一座全省没有一家承包商肯投标的水坝，他说修起来才是这整项规划的全部。（build a dam）
那座坝，指的是那道墙本身而不是那片水库，立了十八年而没有衬砌。（dam）
那条山谷里每一座水坝都有同一道闸门对着它。（dam）
末尾那一座坝，指的是他们留作汛期用的那一座，是唯一有人检查过两次的。（dam）
农夫说这片水就是那条山谷的全部，指的是坝后拦起来的那一片水而不是那道墙。（dam）
1977 年助手说，一座水坝是唯一会因为被守住而变得更好的东西。（dam）
answers: In 1948 the engineer built a dam that no contractor in the province would have tendered, and he said the building was the whole of the scheme.

Every dam in that valley had the same sluice gate against it.
The dam at the end, meaning the one they kept for the flood season and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever inspected twice.
The farmer said the dam was the whole of the valley, meaning the water behind it and not the wall.
